Stage 1 component distributions. The layer1 layer. Facets show components 1-3 in decomposition
order; stored densities summarize sample-coordinate distributions; rugs mark sample
coordinates; dotted vertical lines mark zero; Density fills, outlines, and rug colours encode
categorical planted_group. The analysis unit is independent biological observation; the design
is cross_sectional; the estimand is the descriptive distribution of sample coordinates.
Numerically degenerate density slices (PC1 (planted_group = high)) have insufficient coordinate
spread for kernel-density estimation at sqrt(machine precision) x max(1, maximum absolute
coordinate); those slices appear as rugs only. No component-selection threshold is applied.
This descriptive gallery does not rank or nominate a biological coordinate.
